decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel is core to the firm's strategy of binding mobile communication, its value is still uncertain after one year, and it builds on existing infrastructure, so keeping it costs little.
Mobile PDF signing fits the stated direction toward online contract signing and sits close to existing SDKs, so the option is cheap to hold while eIDAS-driven demand plays out.
The multi-layer end-to-end architecture is largely a framing of the firm's integrated offer, so carrying it costs almost nothing and it supports positioning in regulated markets.
The email-to-app delivery robot is a niche add-on with uncertain uptake, but it extends the secure messaging channel at low marginal cost, so the option is still worth holding.

The hardware QR token has higher carrying costs for production and logistics and faces a market shifting toward app-based authentication, yet after one year the uncertainty is not resolved and PSD2 creates demand from customers without smartphones.

The payment security compliance suite addresses regulatory requirements such as PSD2 and PCI that are still unfolding, so its option value remains while the firm's broad portfolio limits the cost of holding it.
